item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 11:15 AM 03 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Balud, Mandaon, Milagros), #NorthernSamar(SanJose, Rosario and SanAntonio) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthernSamar(SanIsidro, Victoria, Bobon, Catarman and LopeDeVega) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
